//: Typecheck config for the ags-platform package (the ports, the shared
adapters, the entry point). HAND-WRITTEN AND COMMITTED.
WHY IT EXISTS. `ags bundle` TRANSPILES WITHOUT TYPE CHECKING; a type error
in the package would ship silently. This is the gate that removes that
silence. AD-23 puts it on a SELF-HOSTED linux runner because it needs the
desktop stack: the `gi://*` and `ags/*` modules resolve against the
machine's generated GIR declarations, not against anything committed here.
GENERATE THE TYPES FIRST. `ags types -d . -u` writes ./@girs/ (the machine's
GIR declarations), ./env.d.ts and ./tsconfig.json, and creates the
./node_modules/ags + ./node_modules/gnim links. All of those are gitignored.
This file deliberately uses a non-colliding name because `ags types -u`
OVERWRITES tsconfig.json on every run.
THIRD-PARTY ERRORS ARE TOLERATED BY THE GATE, NOT BY THIS FILE. The AGS
runtime ships .ts sources; with `ags` resolving to /usr/share/ags/js they
are typechecked too, and a few are machine/GIR-version dependent. The
`typecheck` Makefile target fails only on errors in THIS repo's tree and
counts the /usr/share/ags/js/ ones - the same shape as dotfiles-v3's
bar-typecheck gate.
resolveJsonModule is REQUIRED: adapters/icon-registry.ts imports the
build-time manifest ../icons.json. allowImportingTsExtensions is REQUIRED:
the source uses explicit .ts specifiers, which Node's type-stripping test
runner needs (see tests/tsconfig.tests.json).
